rows.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next
rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-Next may support multi-step repair with long tool use on sufficiently large local hardware. It has 80B total/3B active parameters; KiCad validation and cutoff-date card status remain unknown.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct has local deployment; comparison depends on differing from prior trials. Prior stack details, superior KiCad results, memory fit and accuracy remain unestablished. Verify tokenizer/function-call handling.

rows.name: Freerouting KiCad integration
rows.reason: Freerouting routes PCB tracks through Specctra DSN/SES after placement/net assignment. It does not design circuits or repair incorrect netlists; review constraints/results. JSON/API bridge remains experimental.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next
rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-Next supports local tool serving but has 80B total parameters, not merely 3B active. Prior-stack novelty, superior KiCad results and direct image handling remain unverified; memory limits unconditional recommendation.

rows.name: Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct (2512)
rows.reason: Local coding/functions/images candidate; prior models/quantizations/hardware/context/logs unknown, possibly already tried. Exact-stack KiCad superiority unproven. Hosted deprecation differs from released-weight self-hosting; verify client image transport.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct supports coding-agent/tool-call workflows, but 30.5B total weights need sufficient memory. Verify serving template/parser and quantization; coding claims do not establish PCB competence.

rows.name: Kibana
rows.reason: Kibana queries, visualizes and manages Elasticsearch data. On-premises deployment is supported, but its product role does not supply a replacement language model for KiCad MCP.

rows.name: KiCad CLI ERC/DRC feedback loop
rows.reason: Machine-readable ERC/DRC reports guide local-agent connectivity/board repairs after bounded edits. Manual is nightly; verify installed-release flags. Passing checks does not prove intended circuit behavior.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder
rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder documents downloadable, locally served coding models with model-specific function-call parsing. Checkpoint, hardware, quantization, baseline novelty and KiCad behavior remain unresolved; no demonstrated upgrade is established.

rows.name: Compare 4–6-bit models on the same KiCAD task with a reduced tool set
rows.reason: Comparing 4–6-bit variants of the same base model on one circuit, then reducing tool count separately, can isolate quantization and tool-selection failures.

rows.name: Devstral Small 2 (24B)
rows.reason: Local coding-agent model accepts images for KiCad screenshots/tool iteration. Inference stack must preserve image/tool support; published software benchmarks do not establish electronics-design quality.

rows.name: Kibana
rows.reason: Kibana visualizes Elasticsearch data; it supplies neither a local coding model nor schematic connectivity or PCB routing mechanisms, so it does not address the reported failure.

rows.name: Freerouting local CLI as the PCB-routing component
rows.reason: Routes exported KiCad boards through DSN/SES reimport and validation. MCP export/import tools and Java/runtime unverified; wrong nets, unsuitable placement or board-specific electrical constraints can invalidate results.

rows.name: Compare 4–6-bit models on the same KiCAD task with a reduced tool set
rows.reason: Treat precision/tool comparison as diagnostic, not a proven replacement. Compare 4/5/6-bit variants on fixed circuit/tools, then vary tools separately; preserve schematic/routing functions and judge connectivity/rules to avoid confounding.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder
rows.reason: Its local 30B variant and dedicated tool parser fit MCP orchestration; coding-agent capabilities make it worth testing, while KiCad routing competence remains unverified.
